question_original: Can I get a child seat with my rental?

question_original: Can I get a free upgrade?
question: Can I get a free upgrade?
original: We cannot promise a free upgrade on request. If your booked category is not available, you get a car from a higher category at no extra cost. Paid upgrades can often be added at the counter, depending on availability.

question: ¿Puedo conseguir una mejora de categoría gratis?
original: No podemos prometer una mejora gratuita a petición. Si la categoría reservada no está disponible, recibe sin coste adicional un coche de una categoría superior. Las mejoras de pago son a menudo posibles en el mostrador, según disponibilidad.

question_original: When will the deposit be released after I return the car?
question: When will the deposit be released after I return the car?
original: We release the deposit as soon as the car has been checked and no damage was found. Depending on your bank, it can take up to 10 days until the amount is available again. For a mid-size car, the blocked amount is 500 EUR.
edited: We release the deposit as soon as the car has been checked and no damage was found. Depending on your bank, it can take up to 10 days until the amount is available again. For a mid-size car, the blocked amount is 500 EUR, and you can also pay it with a debit card.
